Pokémon Psyduck Yellow

Save repair checkpoint · Prototype 0022

Select your original USA HeartGold .nds file, then press the button to create your playable prototype.

Your original file stays on your device. It is never uploaded or changed.

Select your original file to begin.

Download prototype 0022.nds

Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 004, 005, 006 or 007 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. This checkpoint repairs normal-save progress and keeps the campaign at the same completed areas as 0021. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Quest and reward flags now survive daily rollover. Cerulean flags no longer write past the save array. Completed parcel progress is restored where saved evidence supports it; Brock’s Bide and Misty’s BubbleBeam rewards are recognized from retained inventory. The Trainer Card opens on Kanto’s badges. Withdraw the Friendship Charm from your bedroom PC to maximize friendship for all non-Egg party Pokémon; if storage is full, withdraw a stack and reopen the PC. Other evolution requirements still apply. Back up your normal save before switching, and use Continue. Earlier patch pages remain unchanged.
